blocks.content: Evaluation behavior controls two things: how often Grafana runs the query (the evaluation interval) and how long the condition must stay true before the alert actually fires (the pending period).
To set evaluation behavior, complete the following steps:

In the **Set evaluation behavior** section, select or create an **Evaluation group**.

All rules in the same group share the same evaluation interval. For example, a group called `CPU alerts` with a 1-minute interval checks every rule in it once per minute.

Set the **Evaluation interval** if you are creating a new group.

This controls how often Grafana runs the query:

| Situation | Recommended interval |
|-----------|-----------------------|
| Critical infrastructure | 1m |
| General monitoring | 5m |

Set the **Pending period** (sometimes called the "for" duration).

This is how long the condition must stay true before the alert fires. It filters out brief spikes that resolve on their own.

| Alert type | Recommended pending period | Why |
|------------|---------------------------|-----|
| CPU spike | 5m | Filters short spikes during deployments |
| Error burst | 2m | Catches sustained error patterns |
| Disk space | 10m | Disk changes slowly, so a longer window is safe |
In the next milestone, you will choose what happens when data is missing or returns an error.
